text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from roughly 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling and fewer evenings spent on CRM updates.

**2. Notes got better, not just faster.** Summaries captured pricing objections and next steps that handwritten notes often missed.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Announcing the tool upfront and offering an opt-out settled most concerns.

**4. Adoption followed managers.** Teams whose leaders reviewed summaries in pipeline meetings stuck with it. Others faded.

**5. Accuracy needs a human.** Product names and numbers still needed a quick check.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It protected the time we use for it.

What has your team learned from AI pilots?
